description: Verify that TCP in CLOSING / LAST-ACK / TIME-WAIT responds with ok and enters CLOSED on application ABORT call (RFC 793 §3.9 p62 Event Processing)
approach:
[Objective]
Late-state ABORT: in CLOSING, LAST-ACK, or TIME-WAIT, ABORT must drop the connection immediately. tc8-dut handles this via tcp_disconnect; verify-probe-A elicits a RST proving the socket is gone.

[Scenario — chronological]
Three iterations, one per state. For each:
1. Per-iter prelude drives DUT to wst (CLOSING / LAST-ACK / TIME-WAIT).
2. Tester (UT) → DUT: ABORT call.
3. Observation: DUT must close (verify-probe replies RST).

[Pass condition]
All three phases close cleanly.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_p<n>_no_handshake_ack — phase n handshake broken
• Fail_p<n>_no_close — phase n DUT did not close after ABORT

verdicts.Pass: DUT closed in all 3 late states on ABORT — normal
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 1 CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p1_no_close: DUT did not close after ABORT in CLOSING
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 2 LAST-ACK
verdicts.Fail_p2_no_close: DUT did not close after ABORT in LAST-ACK
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_handshake_ack: No DUT handshake ACK phase 3 TIME-WAIT
verdicts.Fail_p3_no_close: DUT did not close after ABORT in TIME-WAIT
